== Course of events ==

This event occurred not long after the Woggle-Bug had joined the traveling party, having told the others his life story as an ordinary tiny Woggle-Bug who once lived among stones and grass roots, and after he had announced his intention to visit the Emerald City to lecture on the 'Advantages of Magnification.' At some point during this period, two girls looked upon the Woggle-Bug and fell from a window in fright at the sight of him.

The Professor and pupils, alarmed by the girls' fall, rushed to check on them. In the confusion of that moment, the Woggle-Bug seized the opportunity to escape. He emerged from the incident permanently enlarged, a change that would remain with him from that point forward.

Following this event, the Woggle-Bug continued on with the party as they faced further trials, including the illusions conjured by Old Mombi and the guidance later offered toward the Emerald City by the Queen of the Field Mice.
